bio: Clinging to the ramparts of this historical village, the delightful Maison embodies the art de vivre of Provence. The chef crafts bright, flavoursome dishes, such as a supreme of free-range poultry, Roman-style gnocchi and meatballs in jus. The decadent desserts are fiendishly tempting. Superlative sweeping view over Mt Ventoux and the Luberon mountain range from the terrace....
